id: 07_Lesson 10 How to Fix Incomplete Handheld Cutting
title: 手持激光切割切不透怎么办
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/07_Lesson 10 How to Fix Incomplete Handheld Cutting.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/07_Lesson 10 How to Fix Incomplete Handheld Cutting/src.py

points.K2: 原因一：准备不足——换切割嘴
points.K10: 原因二：操作不当——45度慢拉
points.K11: 反射区不站人，路径无易燃物
points.K16: 还不行：整理信息去报修

shots.scene: 欣欣站在焊接台旁，手里拿着一块没切断的金属板，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a welding bench holding a metal sheet with an unfinished cut line and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：手持激光切割切不透怎么办。
overlay: 手持激光切割切不透怎么办

shots.scene: 三个问号图标分别连着工具、手、屏幕
shots.prompt_en: Three question mark icons linked to a toolbox, a hand holding a welding head and a touchscreen. No people.
shots.narration: 从准备、操作、参数三方面查。

shots.scene: 阿杰掰着一块只切了一半的钢板，皱眉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in welding gear tries to snap apart a steel sheet that was only half cut, frowning.
shots.narration: 阿杰切了半天，钢板还是连着。

shots.scene: 老李拿着一张空白检查单
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds up a blank three-item checklist.
shots.narration: 老李说：切不透，原因有三类。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们一项一项来查。

shots.scene: 金属板上一条没切透的切缝特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a metal sheet with a cut line that only partly goes through, light showing through in a few spots. No people.
shots.narration: 用焊接头切金属板，切不透。

shots.section_title: 原因一：准备不足——换切割嘴
shots.scene: 空白章节卡，工具箱图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank chapter card with a toolbox icon and the number one. No people.
shots.narration: 原因一：切之前没准备好。
overlay: 原因一：准备不足——换切割嘴

shots.section_title: 原因一：准备不足——换切割嘴
shots.scene: 戴手套拆下焊丝，拔出焊接嘴
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands remove the welding wire and pull the welding tip off the handheld welding head.
shots.narration: 先拆下焊丝，拔出焊接嘴。

shots.section_title: 原因一：准备不足——换切割嘴
shots.scene: 装上细长的切割嘴
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands insert a slim cutting tip into the welding head.
shots.narration: 装上切割嘴。

shots.scene: 屏幕参考值与切割嘴刻度对照
shots.prompt_en: Split view: a blank value box on the touchscreen and the scale marks on the cutting tip, joined by a matching arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 切割嘴刻度，对准屏幕上的参考值。

shots.scene: 清晰红点打勾，残缺红点打叉
shots.prompt_en: Split view: a clear round red dot with a green check and a broken faint dot with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 开机看红光，要清晰完整。

shots.scene: 喷嘴口被烧黑的图标，旁边扳手
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a scorched nozzle tip next to a small wrench icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不清晰先校准，不然会烧坏喷嘴。

shots.scene: 空压机、氮气瓶、氩气瓶三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an air compressor, a gas cylinder and another gas cylinder with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 可选压缩空气、氮气或氩气，这次用氮气。

shots.scene: 气瓶装减压阀，按扳机时压力表指针移动
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder with a pressure regulator; a gloved hand presses the grip button and trigger while the needle on a blank gauge moves.
shots.narration: 装减压阀，按住握持键和扳机通气。

shots.scene: 压力表指针停在刻度中间
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a blank pressure gauge whose needle settles in the middle of the green range. No people.

shots.scene: 工件夹在台钳上，切割区悬空
shots.prompt_en: A metal sheet clamped in a bench vise with the cutting area hanging free above the floor, a green check beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 切割区要悬空，别碰到支撑。

shots.scene: 熔渣粘在支撑上的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of molten metal sticking the workpiece to a support plate, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不然熔化的金属会粘在支撑上。

shots.scene: 酒精湿巾擦切割区
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand wipes the cutting area with an alcohol wipe.
shots.narration: 用酒精湿巾擦掉油污灰尘。

shots.scene: 记号笔在钢板上画曲线
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand draws a curved guide line on the steel sheet with a marker.
shots.narration: 切曲线，可先画一条引导线。

shots.scene: 数控切割机图标旁边精度靶心
shots.prompt_en: Icon of an enclosed cutting machine next to a precision target icon. No people.
shots.narration: 要求很精确，就用数控切割机。

shots.scene: 戴棉纱手套的手把一块金属靠板压在工件上，沿切线放置
shots.prompt_en: A hand in a white cotton glove presses a straight metal plate down on the workpiece along the cut line.
shots.narration: 切直线，用金属板压住当靠尺。

shots.scene: 工件感应线夹子夹在台钳上
shots.prompt_en: The clamp of the workpiece sensing cable is attached to the metal vise holding the workpiece. No people.
shots.narration: 感应线夹在工件或相连的导体上。

shots.scene: 感应线没夹时，焊接头不出光的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a loose sensing clamp and a welding head with a blocked beam symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 没夹好，焊接头不会出光。

shots.scene: 屏幕选切割、材料和厚度
shots.prompt_en: A touchscreen with a cutting icon selected, and blank material and thickness buttons. No people.
shots.narration: 屏幕选切割，再选材料和厚度。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿焊接服，戴面罩、护目镜和皮手套
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on a welding jacket, laser safety goggles, a face shield and leather gloves.
shots.narration: 出光前穿好焊接服，戴齐防护。

shots.scene: 屏幕点启用出光，弹窗提醒
shots.prompt_en: A gloved finger taps the laser enable button; a pop-up shows face shield and goggles icons. No people besides the finger.
shots.narration: 启用出光，开始切割。

shots.section_title: 原因二：操作不当——45度慢拉
shots.scene: 空白章节卡，手持图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank chapter card with a hand holding a welding head icon and the number two. No people.
shots.narration: 原因二：操作方法不对。
overlay: 原因二：操作不当——45度慢拉

shots.section_title: 原因二：操作不当——45度慢拉
shots.scene: 切割嘴以45度接触工件的示意
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of the cutting tip touching the workpiece at a forty-five degree angle, with an angle arc. No people.
shots.narration: 切割嘴贴着工件，成四十五度。

shots.section_title: 原因二：操作不当——45度慢拉
shots.scene: 阿杰按住扳机，慢慢往后拉，火花向下
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a welding jacket and gloves holds the trigger and slowly pulls the welding head backward along the line; sparks fall downward.
shots.narration: 按住按键，慢慢往后拉。

shots.section_title: 原因二：操作不当——45度慢拉
shots.scene: 快跑的兔子图标打叉，慢走的乌龟打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a running rabbit crossed out in red and a slow turtle with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 拉得太快，就切不透。

shots.section_title: 反射区不站人，路径无易燃物
shots.scene: 切割点周围画出反射区，人形图标在区内打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a cutting point with a shaded reflection zone around it; a person icon inside the zone is crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 切割时，反射区里不能站人。
overlay: 反射区不站人，路径无易燃物

shots.section_title: 反射区不站人，路径无易燃物
shots.scene: 激光路径前方的纸箱和溶剂瓶被移走
shots.prompt_en: A cardboard box and a solvent bottle are carried away from the area in front of the cutting line.
shots.narration: 激光路径上不能有易燃物。

shots.scene: 刚切好的工件和切割嘴发红，高温标志
shots.prompt_en: A freshly cut metal piece and the cutting tip glow warm, with a hot surface warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 切完的工件和切割嘴还很烫。

shots.scene: 戴耐热手套掰开工件
shots.prompt_en: Hands in leather heat-resistant gloves snap apart the cut metal sheet.
shots.narration: 不戴防护，别去碰。

shots.scene: 阿杰沿画好的曲线切割
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a welding jacket and gloves cuts along a curved marker line on a steel sheet.
shots.narration: 切曲线，可以照线切，也能直接切。

shots.scene: 手指关闭屏幕上的出光开关
shots.prompt_en: A gloved finger switches off the laser enable toggle on the touchscreen.
shots.narration: 切完马上关出光，防误出光。

shots.scene: 空白章节卡，屏幕图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank chapter card with a touchscreen icon and the number three. No people.
shots.narration: 原因三：参数没设对。

shots.scene: 屏幕上材料和厚度两项被圈出核对
shots.prompt_en: A touchscreen with the material and thickness selections circled for checking. No people.
shots.narration: 先核对材料和厚度选对没有。

shots.scene: 阿杰在高级模式里把功率调高一档
shots.prompt_en: The young male student moves a power slider up one step in the advanced settings on the touchscreen.
shots.narration: 都对还切不透，切到高级模式加功率。

shots.scene: 齿轮图标，更多参数
shots.prompt_en: A gear icon opening a panel of more blank sliders. No people.
shots.narration: 还能在专业设置里细调。

shots.scene: 三张空白卡片：准备、操作、参数
shots.prompt_en: Three blank cards with icons of a toolbox, a hand and a touchscreen. No people.
shots.narration: 准备不足、操作不对、参数不当。

shots.section_title: 还不行：整理信息去报修
shots.scene: 四个图标：文件、日志、序列号、视频
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a grid: a design file, a work log, a serial number label and a video camera. No people.
shots.narration: 还不行，整理好四样资料。
overlay: 还不行：整理信息去报修

shots.section_title: 还不行：整理信息去报修
shots.scene: 阿杰在笔记本电脑上发邮件，附件是四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sends an email on a laptop with four attachment icons and an envelope icon. No text.
shots.narration: 连同已做的步骤，发给厂家售后。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现切割嘴、红点、气瓶、台钳图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to floating icons of a cutting tip, a red dot, a gas cylinder and a vise.
shots.narration: 换嘴对刻度，红光清晰，气压到位。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现45度角和乌龟图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to icons of a forty-five degree angle and a slow turtle.
shots.narration: 四十五度，慢慢拉。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现反射区、纸箱打叉、关出光图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to icons of a reflection zone, a crossed-out cardboard box and a laser toggle switched off.
shots.narration: 反射区不站人，切完关出光。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰举着切好的整齐钢板挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student hold up a neatly cut steel piece and wave goodbye.
shots.narration: 查清原因，一刀切透，下次见！
